concerns.text: Tasks T114 through T120 (Ground Truth Verification, Approximation Limitations, Solvent Analysis, etc.) are present but have no corresponding Functional Requirements (FR-NNN) or Success Criteria (SC-NNN) in spec.md or plan.md. These tasks address simulated reviewer personas (Curie, Franklin, etc.) rather than project specifications, creating unimplemented scope.

FR-004 and FR-005 (DFT Baseline & Paired T-Test) lack complete task coverage. Task T020a (subset selection) and T020b (DFT calculation) are marked incomplete (checkbox unchecked). T021 (training) and T022 (evaluation) are also unchecked. No tasks exist to implement the paired t-test logic required by FR-005.

FR-006 (Feature Importance) and FR-007 (Sensitivity Analysis) have incomplete coverage. Task T029 (sensitivity analysis implementation) and T028 (unit test) are unchecked. While T030 and T030b are checked, the core implementation task T029 is missing, leaving the requirement unfulfilled.

Tasks T114-T120 reference specific reviewer personas (e.g., 'Review: Curie/Franklin') and concepts not found in the spec.md or plan.md. These tags are stale references to an external review process not captured in the current project specification, leading to confusion about the source of requirements.
